wileman.linePrev: Than just picking up the mail or the soldiers from the war
wileman.line: This is something that even old man Wileman never seen before
wileman.lineNext: And it's a late afternoon on a hot Texas day
stanza: Trains are big and black and smoking, louder than July Four
But everybody's actin' like this might be something more
Than just picking up the mail or the soldiers from the war
This is something that even old man Wileman never seen before
